more_info.overview: Magnesium pyrophosphate is a magnesium salt of diphosphoric acid, also called magnesium diphosphate. The defined anhydrous compound contains two magnesium atoms for each diphosphate group. This distinguishes it from magnesium orthophosphates and from broad magnesium-polyphosphate mixtures. The historical dataset assigns an emulsifying role, while a particular food-grade preparation and typical current food examples were not confirmed.
